params.prompt: One continuous photoreal five-second aerial coastal photogrammetry shot beginning exactly from this reference frame. It actively flies along the beach toward the distant upper-center bay, traveling diagonally away from its initial right foreground position. In the first second the six rotors spin rapidly and the drone gently pitches into forward flight. Through seconds 1-5 it travels steadily several body lengths away, gradually becoming smaller, with the underslung survey camera stabilized downward toward the beach. Preserve the same six arms, landing legs, body and camera throughout. Smooth confident cinematic motion and realistic daylight, natural blue sea, sharp terrain texture. No cuts or dissolves, no fixed-image zoom, no hovering in place, no sudden yaw, no extra aircraft, no changing coastline, no laser, no floating grid, no labels or graphics. This is actual-looking survey flight, not a diagram or an abstract animation.
